title: Fluffy Korean Corn Fritters (Mexican-Style)
description: A twist on traditional Mexican fritters, these fluffy corn bites are infused with the bold flavors of Korean chili flakes and the crunch of semolina.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crushed kalguksu, cornmeal, semolina, zesty corn, fluffy corn kernels, and Korean chili flakes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
Note: If the fritters start to break apart, it means the oil is too hot. Reduce the temperature and continue frying.
